turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How's German language quality for your transit announcements?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Excellent — this was actually the deciding factor for us over a competitor whose German sounded accented. Riders have not once flagged the announcements as synthetic.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Anything you'd want improved specifically for this use case?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Better handling of station names with unusual spellings — a few of our stations get mispronounced and we've had to add manual overrides.
